title: Desserts of Detroit Walking Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
not recommended for travelers with food allergies
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Want to see Detroit and try the best desserts?

Part history tour, part dessert tour this walking tour takes you to the most beautiful buildings in Detroit, hidden alleyways with the best dessert and beautiful places to take lots of amazing pictures

This tour covers multiple parts of the city from the Financial District, Riverfront, Greektown, Capitol Park, and restaurant district

FAQs

Whats different from this tour and your other walking tour?

This tour includes almost all of our history tour plus multiple dessert stops. Its 2 tours for the price of 1

How many dessert stops are included?
We will try 4 different desserts from 4 different restaurants, restaurant options change depending of timing and schedule of the restaurants. We have found this is the perfect amount of sugar!

Is this tour allergy friendly?
Our tour is not allergy friendly, we cannot guarantee food safety of any kind in regards to allergy cross contamination and food handling by the restaurant
